input: Return only full Bash code, no explanation. Write scripts/check-miri-smoke-result.sh. set -euo pipefail. Require exactly one readable-file argument, otherwise exit 2. One awk invocation examines that file. Count ALL lines starting "running " and ALL lines starting "test result:". Require exactly one each. Running line must equal "running 1 test". Summary must match anchored regex ^test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; [0-9]+ filtered out; finished in [0-9]+\.[0-9]+s$. Any other running or summary line fails. Missing/duplicate lines fail. awk END exits 1 unless all conditions hold, otherwise 0. No suppressed errors. Only code.
